hero_description: Ever wondered where you can bring your dog without the stress? We built this for you. Gde sa psom helps you find restaurants, cafés, hotels, and more — all verified as pet-friendly by real visitors like you.

site_info: Welcome to Gde sa psom — the go-to platform for pet owners who want to enjoy everyday life with their furry companions. No more guessing “Are dogs allowed here?” — we bring trusted, up-to-date info to one place. Whether you need a cozy café, a pet-friendly hotel, or the nearest vet, we help you find it fast and stress-free.
free_use_description: Our platform is completely free — for visitors and business owners alike. Adding a new place takes just a minute, and it’s always free. We want this community to grow so every pet lover has access to the latest info. Gde sa psom connects people and places that welcome four-legged friends.
how_to_suggest: How to Add a Pet-Friendly Place
how_to_suggest_description: Tap the “Add a Location” button to open a quick form. Fill in the details about the place, and we’ll review and publish it on the site.
important_to_know_description: All info on this site comes from real user experiences. Pet policies at venues can change, so it’s always smart to double-check directly with the place before your visit.

rule_1: Keep your dog under supervision at all times.
rule_2: You are responsible for any damage your dog causes.

rule_4: Dogs must be healthy, microchipped, and vaccinated.
rule_5: No alcohol allowed in the park.
rule_6: No food (except dog treats), glass, or dangerous items.
rule_7: Dogs must be on a leash when entering and leaving.

rule_11: The park is for visitors who follow the rules.
rule_12: Unvaccinated puppies under 4 months are not allowed.
rule_13: Always clean up after your dog.
